Keep life's most exciting moments front and center. Whether you are tracking a long-awaited vacation, an upcoming holiday, or a personal milestone, Time Until brings anticipation to life with an exact countdown timer on your phone.

What are people counting down to right now? 🗓️

• Days until Halloween (October 31, 2026) — costume parties, haunted houses, and trick-or-treating
• Days until Grand Theft Auto VI (November 19, 2026) — stepping back into the open-world franchise
• Days until Thanksgiving (November 26, 2026) — turkey dinner, family gatherings, and holiday football
• Days until Avengers: Doomsday (December 18, 2026) — the return of Marvel's favorite hero in a villainous role
• Days until Christmas Day (December 25, 2026) — unwrapping gifts around the Christmas tree
• Days until Super Bowl LXI (February 14, 2027) — the biggest game and party in American sports

Key features ✨

• Live countdown to the second: Watch the time tick down in real time, from years and months all the way to seconds.
• Days since counter: Switch modes to track days since a sobriety date, quitting a habit, starting a relationship, or celebrating a major life achievement.
• Repeating events: Set recurring reminders that reset automatically every hour, day, week, month, year, or custom interval.
• Timely alarms and reminders: Get notified well in advance or right at the exact moment your event arrives so nothing slips by.

Made for every milestone 🎯

Set an event countdown for a dream beach trip, road trip, or family cruise. Build excitement for birthdays, weddings, baby due dates, and retirement parties. Track study schedules for college finals and bar exams, or mark the calendar for concert tours and festival weekends. You can also monitor positive habits and personal growth by counting every single day since you started.

Custom widgets and personalization 🎨

Put your countdown widget right on your Android home screen in multiple shapes and sizes. Customize each display using your own gallery photos, motion video backgrounds, stylish fonts, and curated color palettes to match your wallpaper perfectly.

Share the excitement 📲

Celebrate together with friends and family. Share your countdown as a picture, export an animated video clip for social media, or send a Live Link so anyone can open a web browser and watch the clock tick in real time.

Simple backup and Premium options 💎

Time Until is free to download and includes local backup files to keep your data safe. If you want more, upgrading to Premium unlocks unlimited active countdowns, cloud backups across devices, access to all fonts and colors, and an ad-free experience.

Pick a date that matters to you, create your first event, and enjoy the excitement of watching every second count down.

Count down days until big events or days since milestones with custom widgets.

I've had this app for a long time, probably close to 6 years at this point and does a great job at what it's designed for. Remains persistent for years, its a really simple app and I've never had an issue with it. I never used premium but still tolerable to use with free + ads. Works great for time since a date and time until a date. Easy to configure date/times, had to get used to the new UI. Overall no complaints, does its job even for long running tracking. My own review and long time user.

7 people found this review helpful

August 3, 2026

Really appreciate the loyalty and the time to write this!

It's a great app for counting down to big events. Works for what I use it for, counting down to big days (wedding, pregnancy milestones etc) and even keeps count beyond those days so it works for keeping track of days since my last drink etc. My favorite part is how few permissions are required to use it. This can't be understated. Some stuff is locked behind premium, but I'm not going to need more than 5 countdowns going at a time so it's fine for me. Free app is worth it!

71 people found this review helpful

The app does what it says, but even the premium version is quite simplistic. There seems no way to add more than one reminder (i.e., if set for 15 minutes before the event end, that's all there is -- no notification that time is up). There is only one notification type (the standard one for the device), so third-party apps like Notificon are needed to change the sound. I wanted a countdown timer for my water kefir and although I use it, I may use another soon.
